info.name: Masar API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Masar ride-sharing platform.

Base URL: http://localhost:8000/api

## Authentication

All endpoints except `GET /payment-methods` and `Health Check` require `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` (set automatically from collection variables).

- **Driver endpoints** (trips, subscriptions, plans, onboarding) → use a token from a user with role `driver`.
- **Admin endpoints** (`/admin/*`) → use a token from a user with role `admin`.

## Running a flow

1. `Auth > Registration` (or `Login`) to obtain an `access_token`.
2. Use `Upload > Upload Image` to get image IDs for onboarding.
3. `Onboarding (Driver)` to complete driver profile + vehicle.
4. `Subscriptions (Driver)` to browse plans and subscribe.
5. `Admin` to approve requests.
6. `Trips` to publish, start, and complete trips (gated by subscription balance).

request.description:
Check if the API is running.

item.name: Auth
Registration

request.description:
Start registration by sending your phone number. An OTP is generated and logged to the server console (dev mode).

**Body fields**
- `country_code` *(string, required)* — 2-letter ISO country code. Options: e.g. `JO`, `AE`. Letters only.
- `phone` *(string, required)* — phone number **without** country code (digits only, e.g. `791234565`).
- `role` *(string, required)* — account role. Options: `driver` | `passenger`.

Verify the OTP received in the server console. Returns a `registration_token` used in Step 3.

**Body fields**
- `phone` *(string, required)* — full phone number in international format, e.g. `+962791234565`.
- `otp` *(string, required)* — the 6-digit code from the console. Replace with the actual code.

Set your password using the `registration_token` from Step 2 (sent as `Authorization: Bearer`). Returns `access_token` and `refresh_token`.

**Body fields**
- `password` *(string, required)* — at least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, a number, and a special character (`@$!%*?&`).
- `confirmPassword` *(string, required)* — must match `password`.

Resend an OTP if the previous one expired or was not received.

**Body fields**
- `phone` *(string, required)* — full phone number in international format, e.g. `+962791234567`.
- `purpose` *(string, required)* — OTP purpose. Options: `register` | `forgot_password`.

item.description:
Two-step registration flow for passengers and drivers.

Step 1: Send phone → receive OTP
Step 2: Verify OTP → receive registration token
Step 3: Set password → receive JWT tokens

request.description:
Login with phone and password. On success, `access_token` and `refresh_token` are stored in collection variables automatically.

**Body fields**
- `phone` *(string, required)* — full phone number in international format, e.g. `+962791234565`.
- `password` *(string, required)* — account password.

Exchange an expired `access_token` for a fresh token pair.

**Body fields**
- `refresh_token` *(string, required)* — the refresh token obtained at login/registration.

Logout and revoke the refresh token.

**Body fields**
- `refresh_token` *(string, required)* — the refresh token to revoke.

Request an OTP to reset your password.

**Body fields**
- `phone` *(string, required)* — full phone number in international format, e.g. `+962791234567`.

Verify the forgot-password OTP. Returns a `reset_token` used in Step 3.

**Body fields**
- `phone` *(string, required)* — full phone number in international format.
- `otp` *(string, required)* — the 6-digit code.

Reset the password using the `reset_token` from Step 2 (sent as `Authorization: Bearer`).

**Body fields**
- `password` *(string, required)* — at least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, a number, and a special character.
- `confirmPassword` *(string, required)* — must match `password`.

Resend the forgot-password OTP. Same endpoint as registration resend, with a different purpose.

**Body fields**
- `phone` *(string, required)* — full phone number in international format.
- `purpose` *(string, required)* — Options: `register` | `forgot_password`.

Get the current authenticated user's profile. Includes `total_balance` and `is_in_debt` for drivers.

No body or query parameters.

item.name: Driver Onboarding

request.description:
Check current driver onboarding progress (which steps are completed).

Requires role `driver`.

No body or query parameters.

Submit driver profile with personal info and document image IDs (obtained from `Upload > Upload Image`).

Requires role `driver`.

**Body fields**
- `fullName` *(string, required)* — full name, max 120 chars.
- `age` *(number, required)* — integer between 18 and 100.
- `gender` *(string, required)* — Options: `male` | `female`.
- `nationalID` *(string, required)* — national ID, 5-30 chars. Used for free-plan one-time eligibility.
- `userIdentificationFront` / `userIdentificationBack` *(number, required)* — image IDs of national ID front/back.
- `linceseFront` / `linceseBack` *(number, required)* — image IDs of driver license front/back (note the typo is intentional in the API).
- `personalImageWithId` *(number, required)* — image ID of a selfie holding the ID.

Get the current driver profile and its status.

Requires role `driver`.

No body or query parameters.

Submit vehicle details with document image IDs.

Requires role `driver`.

**Body fields**
- `vehicleType` *(string, required)* — Options: `sedan` | `suv` | `van` | `bus` | `hatchback`.
- `manufacturer` *(string, required)* — e.g. `Toyota`, max 80 chars.
- `model` *(string, required)* — e.g. `Camry`, max 80 chars.
- `modelYear` *(number, optional)* — integer between 1900 and 2030.
- `color` *(string, optional)* — max 30 chars.
- `plateNumber` *(string, required)* — max 20 chars.
- `seats` *(number, required)* — integer between 1 and 50.
- `registrationDocFront` / `registrationDocBack` *(number, required)* — image IDs of registration document front/back.
- `vehiclePhotoFront` / `vehiclePhotoBack` *(number, required)* — image IDs of vehicle photos front/back.

Get the current driver's vehicle and its status.

Requires role `driver`.

No body or query parameters.

item.description: Driver onboarding: status, driver profile, and vehicle steps (all require role `driver`)

item.name: Upload

request.description:
Upload an image file (multipart/form-data). Returns an image ID used by the onboarding endpoints and subscription `screenshot_id`.

**Form field**
- `file` *(file, required)* — select an image from the `file` value picker.

item.description: File upload used to obtain image IDs for onboarding and subscription proof

item.name: Trips

query.description: Gender filter (optional). Options: all | women_only | men_only

request.description:
Search for available (published) trips. Use for passengers browsing trips.

**Query parameters**
- `origin_city` *(optional)* — e.g. `Amman`.
- `destination_city` *(optional)* — e.g. `Irbid`.
- `date` *(optional)* — `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `gender_preference` *(optional)* — Options: `all` | `women_only` | `men_only`.

Publish a new trip. Requires role `driver` with an **active subscription plan and sufficient balance** (else `422 NO_ACTIVE_PLAN` / `INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE`). On success, `trip_id` is saved to a collection variable automatically.

**Body fields**
- `origin_city` *(string, required)* — max 100 chars.
- `origin_area` *(string, optional)* — max 120 chars.
- `origin_lat` / `origin_lng` *(string, optional)* — decimal; lat −90..90, lng −180..180.
- `destination_city` *(string, required)* — max 100 chars.
- `destination_area` *(string, optional)* — max 120 chars.
- `destination_lat` / `destination_lng` *(string, optional)* — decimal; lat −90..90, lng −180..180.
- `departure_date` *(string, required)* — `YYYY-MM-DD`, today or in the future.
- `departure_time` *(string, required)* — 24h `HH:MM`.
- `type_of_trip` *(string, required)* — Options: `once` | `repeated`.
- `repeated_days` *(array, required when type is `repeated`)* — weekdays as integers. Options: `0` (Sunday) … `6` (Saturday).
- `repeated_end_date` *(string, required when type is `repeated`)* — `YYYY-MM-DD`, after `departure_date`.
- `fare_per_seat` *(string, required)* — decimal with up to 2 decimal places, ≥ 0.
- `seats` *(array, required)* — each item: `{ "seat_number": number, "type": "driver" | "available" | "unavailable" }`.
- `instructions` *(array, optional)* — non-empty strings, max 1000 chars each.
- `additional_instructions` *(string, optional)* — max 1000 chars.
- `waypoints` *(array, optional)* — each item: `{ "stop_name", "stop_lat", "stop_lng" }`.
- `allowed_type` *(string, optional)* — Options: `all` | `women_only` | `men_only`.

Publish a recurring (repeated) trip — same fields as `Create Trip`, with `type_of_trip: "repeated"` plus the recurring fields below.

**Body fields (recurring-specific)**
- `type_of_trip` *(string)* — must be `repeated`.
- `repeated_days` *(array, required)* — weekday integers. Options: `0` (Sunday) … `6` (Saturday).
- `repeated_end_date` *(string, required)* — `YYYY-MM-DD`, must be after `departure_date`.

All other fields match `Create Trip (Driver)`.

Get full details of a single trip.

**Path parameter**
- `trip_id` *(UUID, required)* — set automatically when creating a trip, or paste a trip UUID.

Get all trips for the authenticated driver (newest first).

Requires role `driver`.

No query parameters.

query.description: Filter by trip status. Options: published | full | in_progress | ongoing | completed | cancelled

request.description:
Get the driver's trips filtered by status.

Requires role `driver`.

**Query parameters**
- `status` *(optional)* — Options: `published` | `full` | `in_progress` | `ongoing` | `completed` | `cancelled`.

Mark a trip as `in_progress`. Re-checks the driver's subscription minimum balance — returns `422 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE` if the balance can't cover one-seat commission.

Requires role `driver`.

**Path parameter**
- `trip_id` *(UUID, required)*.

No body.

Complete a trip and deduct the commission from the driver's subscription balance (FIFO across active plans). If the balance runs out the driver goes into debt and trips are blocked.

Requires role `driver`.

**Path parameter**
- `trip_id` *(UUID, required)*.

No body.

Temporarily lock a seat on a trip (reserved while the passenger confirms).

Requires a passenger/authenticated user.

**Path parameter**
- `trip_id` *(UUID, required)*.

**Body fields**
- `seat_number` *(number, required)* — positive integer seat number.

Release a previously locked seat so it becomes bookable again.

**Path parameters**
- `trip_id` *(UUID, required)*.
- `seat_number` *(number, required)* — the locked seat number to release.

Get the authenticated driver's dashboard summary.

item.name: Subscriptions (Driver)

request.description:
Get the active subscription plan catalog (Redis-cached, 60s TTL). Includes the free plan with its `free_offer`.

Requires role `driver`.

No query parameters.

Get the active payment methods drivers can use to pay for a subscription.

Public — no authentication required.

No query parameters.

Submit a subscription request for admin approval. Returns `201` with status `pending_approval`.

Requires role `driver`.

**Body fields**
- `plan_id` *(UUID, required)* — the plan to subscribe to (from `List Active Plans`).
- `payment_method_id` *(UUID, required)* — the payment method used (from `List Payment Methods`).
- `screenshot_id` *(integer, required)* — the image ID returned by `Upload Image` for the payment proof screenshot.
- `resubmit` *(boolean, optional)* — set `true` to cancel an older pending request for the same plan and create a new one. Options: `true` | `false`.

Duplicate pending requests for the same plan return `409 DUPLICATE_SUBSCRIPTION_REQUEST`.

Get all of the authenticated driver's subscriptions, newest first (pending, active, rejected, cancelled, expired).

Requires role `driver`.

No query parameters.

Get the driver's current active plan (queue order: free plan first, then shortest period, then submission FIFO) plus `total_balance` and `is_in_debt`.

Requires role `driver`.

`subscription` is `null` when there is no active plan.

No query parameters.

item.description: Driver subscription plans: browse the catalog, pay via a method, and track the current active plan and balance

item.name: Admin

request.description:
List all plans including inactive ones (each item has `is_active`).

Requires role `admin`.

No query parameters.

Create a subscription plan. Returns `201` with the plan. `plan_id` is not captured automatically — copy it into the `plan_id` collection variable.

Requires role `admin`.

**Body fields**
- `name` *(string, required)* — plan name, max 100 chars.
- `period_days` *(number, required)* — plan length in days, positive integer.
- `percentage_cut` *(string, optional, default 0)* — commission percentage deducted at trip completion, decimal 0–100 (e.g. `"8.00"`).
- `cost` *(string, optional, default 0)* — price of the plan, decimal ≥ 0 (e.g. `"100.00"`).
- `status` *(string, optional, nullable)* — plan tag. Options: `most_requested` | `frequent` | `popular` (or `null`).
- `features` *(array, optional)* — list of feature strings, max 200 chars each.
- `is_free` *(boolean, optional, default false)* — whether this is the free plan. Options: `true` | `false`. Only one free plan may be active at a time (`409 FREE_PLAN_EXISTS`).
- `free_offer` *(object, required when `is_free: true`)* — `{ "type": "trips" | "credit", "value": number }`.

**Free plan example body**
```json
{
  "name": "Free Trial",
  "period_days": 30,
  "percentage_cut": "0.00",
  "cost": "0.00",
  "features": [],
  "is_free": true,
  "free_offer": { "type": "trips", "value": 5 }
}
```

Update an existing plan. All fields are optional (partial update). Invalidates the driver plan cache.

Requires role `admin`.

**Path parameter**
- `plan_id` *(UUID, required)*.

**Body fields** — same field rules as `Create Plan`; only include fields you want to change: `name`, `period_days`, `percentage_cut`, `cost`, `status` (`most_requested` | `frequent` | `popular` | `null`), `features`, `is_free`, `free_offer`.

item.name: Deactivate Plan
item.description:
Soft-delete a plan (`is_active = false`). The plan is hidden from drivers immediately; pending requests on it can no longer be approved.

Requires role `admin`.

**Path parameter**
- `plan_id` *(UUID, required)*.

No body.

request.description:
List all payment methods including inactive ones (each item has `is_active`).

Requires role `admin`.

No query parameters.

Create a payment method drivers can choose when paying for a subscription. Returns `201`.

Requires role `admin`.

**Body fields**
- `name` *(string, required)* — max 100 chars.
- `account_number` *(string, required)* — max 50 chars.
- `type` *(string, required)* — Options: `bank_account` | `e-wallet` | `mobile_money`.
- `email` *(string, optional, nullable)* — valid email if provided.

Update an existing payment method. All fields are optional (partial update).

Requires role `admin`.

**Path parameter**
- `payment_method_id` *(UUID, required)*.

**Body fields** — same rules as `Create Payment Method`: `name`, `account_number`, `type` (`bank_account` | `e-wallet` | `mobile_money`), `email`.

Soft-delete a payment method (`is_active = false`). Hidden from the public list immediately.

Requires role `admin`.

**Path parameter**
- `payment_method_id` *(UUID, required)*.

No body.

query.description: Filter by subscription status (optional). Options: pending_approval | active | rejected | cancelled | expired

request.description:
List subscription requests awaiting action. The driver's National ID is **masked** server-side (`****1234`) and never returned raw.

Requires role `admin`.

**Query parameters**
- `status` *(optional, default `pending_approval`)* — Options: `pending_approval` | `active` | `rejected` | `cancelled` | `expired`.
- `sort` *(optional)* — Options: `newest` | `oldest`.

Approve a pending subscription request. Credits the driver's balance (clears any debt first), activates the plan, and sends a notification. First action wins — a second approve/reject returns `409 REQUEST_ALREADY_PROCESSED`.

Requires role `admin`.

**Path parameter**
- `subscription_id` *(UUID, required)* — from the Pending Queue.

No body.

Reject a pending subscription request with a reason (sent to the driver via SMS + in-app notification). First action wins.

Requires role `admin`.

**Path parameter**
- `subscription_id` *(UUID, required)* — from the Pending Queue.

**Body fields**
- `reason` *(string, required)* — rejection reason, max 500 chars.

item.description: Admin management: subscription plans, payment methods, and subscription request approvals (all require role `admin`)

Temporary token returned after OTP verification, used to set the password.
Temporary token returned after forgot-password OTP verification, used to reset the password.
UUID of a trip. Captured automatically when creating a trip; otherwise paste a trip UUID.
UUID of a subscription plan. Copy from List Active Plans (driver) or Create Plan (admin).
UUID of a payment method. Copy from List Payment Methods or Create Payment Method (admin).
UUID of a subscription request. Copy from List My Subscriptions (driver) or the admin Pending Queue.
